endorsements.name: Laurent Sibilla
endorsements.label: CVE-2021-47960
endorsements.description: A files or directories accessible to external parties vulnerability in Synology SSL VPN Client before 1.4.5-0684 allows remote attackers to access files within the installation directory via a local HTTP server bound to the loopback interface. By leveraging user interaction with a crafted web page, attackers may retrieve sensitive files such as configuration files, certificates, and logs, leading to information disclosure.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 6.5)

povs.explanation: A published CVE record provides public, independently verifiable recognition of the credited vulnerability disclosure.

endorsements.name: Laurent Sibilla
endorsements.label: CVE-2021-47961
endorsements.description: A plaintext storage of a password vulnerability in Synology SSL VPN Client before 1.4.5-0684 allows remote attackers to access or influence the user's PIN code due to insecure storage. This may lead to unauthorized VPN configuration and potential interception of subsequent VPN traffic when combined with user interaction.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 3.1, 8.1)
